records.jp: 星崎さん、今、ちょっといい？<CR>少し相談があるんだけど
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, do you have a moment? I was hoping to get your advice on something.
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki, do you have a moment? I was hoping to get your advice on something.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, do you have a moment?<CR>There's something I'd like to consult you about.

records.jp: えっ！　伶那さんが私に相談って珍しいね。<CR>どうしたの？
records.en_original: Huh? You want my advice? This is rare. What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You want my advice? This is rare. What's up?
records.en: Huh! It's unusual for Rena-san to consult me.<CR>What's wrong?

records.jp: ……最近、怖いなって思うことがあって
records.en_original: I've been...afraid of something lately.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been...afraid of something lately.
records.en: ...Recently, there's something I've found frightening.

records.jp: その……。思ったことを素直に伝えると、<CR>相手も自分も傷ついちゃう時って、あるでしょ？
records.en_original: You know how sometimes, being too honest with someone could hurt both them and yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: You know how sometimes, being too honest with someone could hurt both them and yourself?
records.en: You know... When you honestly say what you think,<CR>there are times it hurts both the other person and yourself, right?

records.jp: 特に私はそれで一度失敗してて……そのせいか、<CR>勇希にどれくらい踏み込んでいいのかわからないの
records.en_original: I've made that mistake before... So I'm not sure how open to be with Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: I've made that mistake before... So I'm not sure how open to be with Yuki.
records.en: I failed once because of that in particular... Maybe because of it,<CR>I don't know how far I can step into Yuki's heart.

records.jp: 勇希とは気持ちが通じ合ったと思ってる。<CR>それでも、想いをそのまま伝えたら嫌がられるかもって
records.en_original: I believe we both understand each other very well. But still, I'm not sure if she'll appreciate me being so blunt with her.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe we both understand each other very well. But still, I'm not sure if she'll appreciate me being so blunt with her.
records.en: I believe Yuki and I understand each other's feelings.<CR>Even so, I worry she may dislike it if I express my feelings just as they are.

records.jp: 何より、こういうふうに怖がって足踏みする<CR>私の勇気のなさが……情けなくて、辛い
records.en_original: More than anything, though, I hate that this fear has made me so indecisive and weak...
records.en_auxiliary: More than anything, though, I hate that this fear has made me so indecisive and weak...
records.en: More than anything, my lack of courage—being afraid and unable to move forward<CR>like this—is pathetic and painful.

records.jp: 愛央、みーっけ。今って暇？<CR>ちょっと相談にのって欲しいんだけど
records.en_original: There you are, Ao! Do you have a second? There's something I wanted to ask you.
records.en_auxiliary: There you are, Ao! Do you have a second? There's something I wanted to ask you.
records.en: There you are, Ao. Are you free right now?<CR>There's something I'd like your advice about.

records.jp: あれ、こっちもか……
records.en_original: Oh, you too?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, you too?
records.en: Huh, this one too...

records.jp: え？　なんのこと？
records.en_original: Huh? What are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What are you talking about?
records.en: Huh? What's that about?

records.jp: あー、いやいや！　なんでもないから！<CR>それより相談って？　なんかあった？
records.en_original: Oh, nothing! Don't worry about it! So, what was it that you wanted to talk about?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, nothing! Don't worry about it! So, what was it that you wanted to talk about?
records.en: Ah, no, no! It's nothing!<CR>More importantly, what did you want advice about? Did something happen?

records.jp: うん……えっと……。<CR>あたし、自分でもどうかと思ってる癖があってさ
records.en_original: Well, I sort of have this habit that I want to do something about.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I sort of have this habit that I want to do something about.
records.en: Yeah... Um...<CR>I have a habit that even I think is a problem.

records.jp: 恥ずかしかったり気まずかったりする時、<CR>つい誤魔化したり、嘘をついたりしちゃうんだ
records.en_original: Whenever I feel embarrassed or awkward, I tend to lie or cheat my way out of the situation.
records.en_auxiliary: Whenever I feel embarrassed or awkward, I tend to lie or cheat my way out of the situation.
records.en: When I'm embarrassed or things feel awkward,<CR>I end up glossing over it or telling lies.

records.jp: あたしのことを信じて、大事にしてくれてる人に……<CR>伶那に、どうしても素直になれなくて
records.en_original: I just can't be honest with the one person who's been so trusting and caring... Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: I just can't be honest with the one person who's been so trusting and caring... Rena.
records.en: With someone who trusts me and cares about me...<CR>I just can't be honest with Rena.

records.jp: 本音が言えなくてごめんって思うの。でも……。<CR>ねえ、愛央。どうすれば伶那に想いを伝えられるかな？
records.en_original: I feel awful that I can't tell her how I really feel. Ao, what should I do?
records.en_auxiliary: I feel awful that I can't tell her how I really feel. Ao, what should I do?
records.en: I feel sorry that I can't say what I truly feel. But...<CR>Hey, Ao. How can I convey my feelings to Rena?

records.jp: （……やー、恋人同士って段々似てくるのかな？<CR>二人とも同じように悩んで、同じように想い合ってる）
records.en_original: (Weird... Do couples start to become the same person over time? They're both having similar problems with each other.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Weird... Do couples start to become the same person over time? They're both having similar problems with each other.)
records.en: (...Wow, do lovers gradually become more alike?<CR>They're both troubled in the same way and care for each other in the same way.)

records.jp: （私としては微笑ましいだけなんだけど……。<CR>二人は真剣なんだし、うまくいくよう協力しないと！）
records.en_original: (It's kind of wholesome. They're so serious about each other. I have to help them make it work!)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's kind of wholesome. They're so serious about each other. I have to help them make it work!)
records.en: (To me, it's simply heartwarming...<CR>But they're both serious, so I have to help things work out!)

records.jp: ごめんね。伶那さん。<CR>相談受けた後、ちょっと時間もらっちゃって
records.en_original: Sorry to keep you waiting, Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry to keep you waiting, Rena.
records.en: Sorry, Rena-san.<CR>I took a little time after hearing your problem.

records.jp: それだけ真剣に考えてくれたってことでしょ？<CR>……ありがと、星崎さん
records.en_original: No, I'm glad you took the time you needed to really think about this. Thank you, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm glad you took the time you needed to really think about this. Thank you, Hoshizaki.
records.en: That means you thought about it that seriously, right?<CR>...Thanks, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: へへ。それでね、私なりにいろいろ考えたんだけど……<CR>伶那さんは伶那さんらしく、突撃したらどうかなって
records.en_original: Hehe. So, I was thinking... Why don't you charge in headfirst like you always do?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. So, I was thinking... Why don't you charge in headfirst like you always do?
records.en: Hehe. I thought about all sorts of things in my own way...<CR>How about charging ahead in your own Rena-san-like way?

records.jp: 突撃……？
records.en_original: Charge in headfirst?
records.en_auxiliary: Charge in headfirst?
records.en: Charging ahead...?

records.jp: 確かに勇希は本心を明かさないところがあるから、<CR>不安になるのはわかるんだけど……
records.en_original: Yeah. I know you're worried because Yuki tends to hide her true feelings, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I know you're worried because Yuki tends to hide her true feelings, but...
records.en: Yuki does have a tendency not to reveal her true feelings,<CR>so I understand why you're anxious...

records.jp: それで伶那さんまで遠慮しちゃってたら、いつまでも<CR>本音を引き出せないと思う。だって、あの勇希だよ？
records.en_original: If you keep your thoughts from her as well, you two would never talk heart to heart. This is Yuki we're talking about.
records.en_auxiliary: If you keep your thoughts from her as well, you two would never talk heart to heart. This is Yuki we're talking about.
records.en: But if you start holding back too, Rena-san, I don't think you'll ever<CR>draw out her true feelings. This is Yuki we're talking about, you know?

records.jp: 恋人になるまでだって、紆余曲折の末の突撃だったし。<CR>勇希の心に触れるなら、伶那さんから攻めるしかない！
records.en_original: You charged through a long series of ups and downs to be with Yuki. So if you want to get through to her, you have to strike!
records.en_auxiliary: You charged through a long series of ups and downs to be with Yuki. So if you want to get through to her, you have to strike!
records.en: Even becoming lovers took a charge after all those twists and turns.<CR>If you want to touch Yuki's heart, you have no choice but to go on the offensive, Rena-san!

records.jp: ……突撃とか、攻めるとか。<CR>恋愛相談の答えとは思えない単語ばっかだけど
records.en_original: Charging in and striking... That doesn't really sound very romantic.
records.en_auxiliary: Charging in and striking... That doesn't really sound very romantic.
records.en: ...Charging and going on the offensive.<CR>Those words hardly sound like an answer to a love consultation.

records.jp: でも……星崎さんの言う通りかも。<CR>怖いって言ってる時間すら、私には惜しいはずだしね
records.en_original: But...you may be right, Hoshizaki. I shouldn't waste my precious time being afraid.
records.en_auxiliary: But...you may be right, Hoshizaki. I shouldn't waste my precious time being afraid.
records.en: But... Hoshizaki-san may be right.<CR>Even the time I spend saying I'm afraid should be too precious to waste.

records.jp: 大丈夫。絶対うまくいくよ。だから──
records.en_original: Don't worry, I'm sure it'll all work out! So...
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, I'm sure it'll all work out! So...
records.en: It'll be okay. It'll definitely work out. So—

records.jp: あ、来た来た。待ってたよ！<CR>勇希へのアドバイス、バッチリ用意してきたから！
records.en_original: Good, you came! I've thought long and hard over what kind of advice to give you!
records.en_auxiliary: Good, you came! I've thought long and hard over what kind of advice to give you!
records.en: Ah, there you are. I've been waiting!<CR>I've prepared the perfect advice for Yuki!

records.jp: 微妙に不安になるテンションなんですけど。<CR>……でも、ありがと。いろいろ考えてくれたんだよね
records.en_original: You seem a little too excited about this. But...thanks. You really didn't have to.
records.en_auxiliary: You seem a little too excited about this. But...thanks. You really didn't have to.
records.en: Your energy is making me slightly uneasy.<CR>...But thanks. You thought about all sorts of things for me, right?

records.jp: ふっふっふ。これでも二人を応援してるからね。<CR>で、伶那さんと本音で付き合う方法だけど……
records.en_original: Heheheh, I'm just happy to be helping my favorite couple. So, to be more honest with Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Heheheh, I'm just happy to be helping my favorite couple. So, to be more honest with Rena...
records.en: Heh heh heh. I do support you two, you know.<CR>Now, as for how to face Rena-san with your true feelings...

records.jp: ずばり！　本音を言う努力を重ねるしかない！
records.en_original: All you have to do is make an effort to be more honest with Rena!
records.en_auxiliary: All you have to do is make an effort to be more honest with Rena!
records.en: Namely! You have no choice but to keep making the effort to say what you truly feel!

records.jp: え……。えーっ！？　なんか体育会系じゃない！？
records.en_original: What...? Wait, what?! That's your advice?!
records.en_auxiliary: What...? Wait, what?! That's your advice?!
records.en: Huh...? Whaaat!? Isn't that kind of sports-club advice!?

records.jp: でもさ、ここは頑張って、<CR>勇希が変わるしかないと思うんだ
records.en_original: Well, it's up to you to work on changing your own habits.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, it's up to you to work on changing your own habits.
records.en: But here, I think Yuki has no choice<CR>but to work hard and change.

records.jp: 勇希の本音を隠す癖は、伶那さんもよく分かってる<CR>とは思うけど……だからこそ不安なはずだよ
records.en_original: I'm sure Rena knows that you tend to hide how you feel. That must make her even more anxious.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure Rena knows that you tend to hide how you feel. That must make her even more anxious.
records.en: I'm sure Rena-san understands your habit of hiding your true feelings,<CR>but that's exactly why she must be anxious.

records.jp: 何をしていても、ふとした瞬間に「勇希が本音を<CR>抱え込んでるんじゃないか？」って怖くなったりしてさ
records.en_original: Whenever you're together, a part of her must be worrying whether or not you're being honest with her at that moment.
records.en_auxiliary: Whenever you're together, a part of her must be worrying whether or not you're being honest with her at that moment.
records.en: No matter what you're doing, at some sudden moment she may fear,<CR>'Is Yuki bottling up her true feelings?'

records.jp: 勇希の思い、少しずつでもいいから伝えてあげよう？<CR>きっと伶那さん、喜ぶよ
records.en_original: Try letting her in more, Even just one little thing at a time. I'm sure she'll appreciate that.
records.en_auxiliary: Try letting her in more, Even just one little thing at a time. I'm sure she'll appreciate that.
records.en: Try conveying your feelings, even if only little by little.<CR>I'm sure Rena-san will be happy.

records.jp: ……そう、だよね。うん……頑張らなくちゃ。<CR>伶那はあたしにとって、かけがえのない人なんだから
records.en_original: ...You're right. I have to change. Rena is too important to me not to.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're right. I have to change. Rena is too important to me not to.
records.en: ...You're right. Yeah... I have to try.<CR>Rena is someone irreplaceable to me, after all.

records.jp: うん！　その意気だよ！　それじゃあ──
records.en_original: Yeah! That's the spirit! So...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! That's the spirit! So...
records.en: Yeah! That's the spirit! Then—

records.jp: ……「後はお若い二人でごゆっくり」って。<CR>星崎さん、何者なの
records.en_original: "I'll let you kids talk it out"...? Who does Hoshizaki think she is?
records.en_auxiliary: "I'll let you kids talk it out"...? Who does Hoshizaki think she is?
records.en: ...She said, 'I'll leave you young lovers alone.'<CR>Who exactly is Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: あははっ！　……でもさ、あたしたちのこと、<CR>すごーく心配してくれてるよね。ほんと、いい奴
records.en_original: Hahaha! ...But she has done a lot for us. She's a good friend.
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha! ...But she has done a lot for us. She's a good friend.
records.en: Ahaha! ...But you know, she worries<CR>so much about us. She's really a good person.

records.jp: ……勇希も星崎さんにいろいろ相談してたんだね
records.en_original: I guess she was consulting with you too, huh, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess she was consulting with you too, huh, Hoshizaki.
records.en: ...So Yuki asked Hoshizaki-san about all sorts of things too.

records.jp: うん……。あたし……。……あたし、<CR>どうしても本音を隠しちゃう癖があるから
records.en_original: Y-yeah... I... Sometimes I just can't help hiding how I feel.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah... I... Sometimes I just can't help hiding how I feel.
records.en: Yeah... I... I have a habit<CR>of hiding what I truly feel no matter what.

records.jp: 私も、本音を勇希に伝えるのが怖かった。<CR>勇希の心に踏み込んで、嫌がられたら……って
records.en_original: I was scared to be honest with you too. I thought I'd go too far and make you hate me...
records.en_auxiliary: I was scared to be honest with you too. I thought I'd go too far and make you hate me...
records.en: I was afraid to tell Yuki what I truly feel too.<CR>I worried that if I stepped into your heart, you might dislike it...

records.jp: あたしたち、似たようなことで悩んでたんだね
records.en_original: Sounds like we were both worrying over the same thing.
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds like we were both worrying over the same thing.
records.en: We were worried about similar things, weren't we?

records.jp: ……嬉しい、よ。<CR>伶那とこういうふうに……想い合えて……
records.en_original: ...I'm happy, you know. That we both...feel the same way about each other.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm happy, you know. That we both...feel the same way about each other.
records.en: ...I'm happy.<CR>That Rena and I can care for each other like this...

records.jp: ……うん。私も嬉しい。<CR>勇希のこと、好きになってよかった
records.en_original: I'm happy too. I'm so lucky to be in love with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm happy too. I'm so lucky to be in love with you.
records.en: ...Yeah. I'm happy too.<CR>I'm glad I fell in love with Yuki.

records.jp: ……今度二人で、星崎さんにお礼言わなくちゃね
records.en_original: ...I suppose we'll have to say thanks to Hoshizaki, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: ...I suppose we'll have to say thanks to Hoshizaki, huh?
records.en: ...Next time, we'll have to thank Hoshizaki-san together.
